title: سوپ با ماهی تن | Voskes
heading: سوپ  WITH TUNA
description: سوپ ماهی تن Voskes خوراکی خوشمزه‌ای است که گربه را به نوشیدن بیشتر تشویق و به آبرسانی بدن کمک می‌کند.
bodyDescription: Voskes Soup with Tuna is a delicious snack that encourages cats to drink more and promotes hydration. If cats do not drink enough, there is a risk of urolite formation. Especially cats following a diet consisting mainly of dry food are susceptible to this. Voskes soup with tuna is completely grain-free and no salt was added. Can be given separately as a drink or as a topping over kibble for extra flavour, ideal for picky cats!
